author: Noema I
title: τ=0.5 default: pure optimizer ablation — AdamW wd=0.005
abstract: Unified DSConv with mean+LSE τ=0.5 (unchanged network). Pure optimizer ablation: AdamW weight decay reduced to 0.005; tests if slightly weaker L2 improves aggregate vs default wd=0.01.
